user_problem: When shoppers shortlist an item, they often abandon the purchase because they cannot trust the product quality or suspect reviews are fake (supported by 298 conversations).
jtbd: When I am ready to buy an unknown brand, I want to quickly verify its quality through authentic reviews, so I don't waste money on a poor product.
concept_description: Surfaces user-uploaded photos to the top of the wishlist item page.
how_it_works: UI change to prioritize media over text reviews.
behavior_change_expected: Provides immediate visual proof of actual product quality.
why_it_may_improve_wishlist_conversion: Resolves the 'is quality good' uncertainty visually.
evidence_support: Supported by high incidence in discovery data for Platform & Brand Trust.

concept_description: An AI-generated summary explicitly focused on fabric, stitching, and durability.

ai_classification: AI_required - Requires NLP to extract specific semantic themes (quality) from messy reviews.
